description: This is a test class for UserController in a Java Spring Boot project, containing unit tests for user-related functionalities such as getUser, emailExists, updateEmail, updatePassword, and register, using Mockito and JUnit 5.

classes.name: UserControllerTest
classes.description: Test class for UserController, containing unit tests for user management endpoints.

methods.name: getUser_returnsUser_ifPresent
methods.description: Tests that getUser returns the user when present.

methods.name: getUser_returnsNotFound_ifUserIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that getUser throws ResponseStatusException when user is not found.

methods.name: emailExists_returnsOk_ifTrue
methods.description: Tests emailExists returns HTTP 200 OK when email exists.

methods.name: emailExists_returnsNotFound_ifFalse
methods.description: Tests emailExists returns HTTP 404 Not Found when email does not exist.

methods.name: updateEmail_returns404_ifUserNotFound
methods.description: Tests updateEmail returns 404 when current user is not found.

methods.name: updateEmail_returns401_ifPasswordIncorrect

methods.name: updateEmail_returns400_ifNewEmailSameAsCurrent

methods.name: updatePassword_returns401_ifExistingPasswordNotCorrect

methods.name: updatePassword_returnsBadRequest_ifPasswordIsNotVeryStrong
